options.description: The plain-words study is added as its own output. The existing requirement's wording is not changed, and the command keeps working as before. Leaving it alone is the smaller change.
options.label: Sit beside it, leave the requirement as it is (Recommended)

options.description: The existing requirement is rewritten to the plain-words version, so the study becomes the source of the requirement's wording.
options.label: Change the existing requirement to match the study

payload.question: When you asked for a plain-words study of plumb, did you want it to change the existing requirement it describes, or to sit beside that requirement and leave it as it is?
